title: 多哈地鐵~Doha Metro
focus: 海灣自動地鐵熱濕環境與活動尖峰~Gulf automated metro heat humidity and event peaks
summary: 以多哈地鐵為背景，建立高溫潮濕環境與活動散場旅客同時出現的教學案例。學徒從空調、濾材與供電負載追蹤到月台隊列、車門和自動行車，區分日常平均需求與短時大量到達所需的控制措施。~Use Doha Metro to construct a teaching case combining a hot humid environment with a large post-event passenger release. Trace cooling, filters and power demand into platform queues, doors and automated movement. Distinguish normal mean demand from short-duration batch arrivals, and require measurable control actions instead of treating advertised frequency as evidence that every crowd can be absorbed immediately.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 air_rise=12.93532 K；單元 2 得 fan_power=1516.667 W；單元 3 得 capacity=17307.69 persons/hour。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 heat 的擾動測試，結果改為 14.22886 K；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以多哈地鐵為背景，建立高溫潮濕環境與活動散場旅客同時出現的教學案例。學徒從空調、濾材與供電負載追蹤到月台隊列、車門和自動行車，區分日常平均需求與短時大量到達所需的控制措施。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives air_rise=12.93532 K; unit 2 gives fan_power=1516.667 W; unit 3 gives capacity=17307.69 persons/hour. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing heat in the first unit changes its result to 14.22886 K. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Doha Metro to construct a teaching case combining a hot humid environment with a large post-event passenger release. Trace cooling, filters and power demand into platform queues, doors and automated movement. Distinguish normal mean demand from short-duration batch arrivals, and require measurable control actions instead of treating advertised frequency as evidence that every crowd can be absorbed immediately. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2019 年：多哈地鐵紅線南段於五月開始初期旅客服務；2025 年：IEC 發布新版鐵道 RAMS 第一部分通用程序。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以多哈地鐵為背景，建立高溫潮濕環境與活動散場旅客同時出現的教學案例。學徒從空調、濾材與供電負載追蹤到月台隊列、車門和自動行車，區分日常平均需求與短時大量到達所需的控制措施。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2019: The southern Red Line section of Doha Metro began initial passenger service in May; 2025: IEC published the revised railway RAMS Part 1 generic process. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Doha Metro to construct a teaching case combining a hot humid environment with a large post-event passenger release. Trace cooling, filters and power demand into platform queues, doors and automated movement. Distinguish normal mean demand from short-duration batch arrivals, and require measurable control actions instead of treating advertised frequency as evidence that every crowd can be absorbed immediately. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 通風散熱與設備溫升~Ventilation cooling and equipment heat
units.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升~Ventilation cooling and equipment heat
units.mechanism: 流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。設備房還存在短路循環和局部熱點，平均送排風溫差不能保證所有電子模組都在同樣環境中。 顯熱負載決定溫度改變需求，但高濕環境還有潛熱除濕與新風處理。冷卻量和耗電量也不同，兩者需要效率或性能係數連結，不能把熱量數字當作電表讀值。 把顯熱模型與尚未計入的潛熱除濕需求明確分開。~Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise. Insufficient flow raises exhaust temperature. Equipment rooms also contain recirculation and hot spots, so an average supply-to-exhaust difference does not guarantee identical conditions around every electronic module. Sensible load describes temperature-related demand, while humidity introduces latent dehumidification and outdoor-air treatment. Cooling delivered and electricity consumed are different quantities, connected through efficiency or a performance coefficient rather than treated as identical meter readings. Separate the sensible-heat model explicitly from latent dehumidification demand not yet included.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K。敏感度：heat 單獨增加百分之十至 20592 W，其餘固定，結果為 14.22886 K。模型邊界：穩態顯熱且混合均勻；不含潛熱、輻射與空調循環效率。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K. Sensitivity: heat, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 20592 W, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.22886 K. Model boundary: Steady sensible heat and uniform mixing; latent heat, radiation and refrigeration-cycle efficiency are excluded.
units.verify: 同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。 同步量測進出風溫度、流量和耗電，另記濕度與新風比例，確認顯熱邊界一致。~Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment. Measure inlet and outlet air temperature, airflow and electricity together, separately recording humidity and outdoor-air fraction to confirm consistent sensible boundaries.
units.failure: 濾網堵塞或風道短路會降低有效冷卻，即使總風機轉速正常；散熱器積塵也可能提高晶片溫度而房間平均值不變。 濕度升高仍可能需要更多冷量，即使乾球溫度沒有改變。~A blocked filter or airflow bypass reduces effective cooling despite normal fan speed; dusty heat sinks can raise chip temperature without changing the room average. Rising humidity can require more cooling even if the dry-bulb temperature has not changed.
units.misconception: 風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱~Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet.
units.practice: 比較降低風量與增加設備負載兩種情況，建立溫升敏感度表，再選出能辨別旁通流和真正熱負荷增加的測點。 再以本單元 heat 的對照值重算 air_rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare reduced flow with increased equipment load, tabulate temperature sensitivity, and choose sensors distinguishing bypass flow from a genuine load increase. Also recalculate air_rise for the alternative heat value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 濾網壓差與通風功率~Filter pressure drop and fan power
units.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率~Filter pressure drop and fan power
units.mechanism: 風機必須克服風道與濾網壓差才能輸送空氣，輸入功率近似為壓差乘體積流率再除效率。積塵提高阻力但工作點會沿風機曲線改變，因此固定風量假設只是一種受控比較。 風機功率等於壓力差乘體積流率再除以宣告效率，壓力與流量必須使用同一工作點。積塵使阻力和風機工作點共同改變，固定流量算例不能預測未控制風量時的耗電。 在高濕進氣情境下檢查濾材壓差與風量的共同變化。~A fan must overcome duct and filter pressure losses to move air. Input power is approximately pressure rise times volume flow divided by efficiency. Dust raises resistance but shifts the operating point on the fan curve, so fixed flow is only a controlled comparison. Fan power equals pressure difference times volume flow divided by the declared efficiency. Pressure and flow must refer to one operating point. Dust changes resistance and the fan operating point together, so a fixed-flow example cannot predict consumption without airflow control. Examine joint changes in filter pressure drop and airflow under humid intake conditions.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=364 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1；計算：fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1516.667 W。敏感度：pressure 單獨增加百分之十至 400.4 Pa，其餘固定，結果為 1668.333 W。模型邊界：固定風量與總效率；不包含風機曲線移動和馬達熱限制。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=364 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1; calculation: fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1516.667 W. Sensitivity: pressure, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 400.4 Pa, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1668.333 W. Model boundary: Fixed flow and overall efficiency; fan-curve shifts and motor thermal limits are excluded.
units.verify: 同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。 校正取壓點與風量計，同步量測電功率，核對效率是否包含馬達與驅動器損失。~Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing. Calibrate pressure taps and airflow measurement, record electric power simultaneously, and check whether efficiency includes motor and drive losses.
units.failure: 旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 壓差很低也可能是旁通，須核對濾材密封及實際風量。~Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal. Very low pressure drop can indicate bypass; check filter sealing and actual airflow.
units.misconception: 濾網壓差越低就一定表示過濾狀況越好~Lower filter pressure drop always means better filtration condition.
units.practice: 對堵塞與旁路兩個情境列出壓差、風量和粒子濃度的預期方向，設計三項量測共同判斷而非只靠單一數字。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 fan_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Predict pressure drop, airflow and particle concentration for clogging and bypass scenarios, then design a three-measurement diagnosis instead of relying on one number. Also recalculate fan_power for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 班距與有效運能~Headway and usable capacity
units.title: 班距與有效運能~Headway and usable capacity
units.mechanism: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。 此式計算的是通過指定斷面的名目服務率，不能表示月台能容納多少人。需求在空間或時間上集中時，某站可以過載，即使整條線的平均載客率仍低。 用短時散場需求比較逐列服務量，不只報告每小時容量。~Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow. Door exchange, transfer surges and irregular arrivals can prevent the theoretical rate from being realised, so occupancy distribution must accompany the capacity estimate. This expression estimates a nominal service rate across a specified section, not how many people a platform can hold. Concentrated demand can overload one station even when average occupancy across the complete line remains relatively low. Compare successive train service with a short event-release surge, not only hourly capacity.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=187.2 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17307.69 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 205.92 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 15734.27 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=187.2 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17307.69 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 205.92 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15734.27 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded.
units.verify: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。~Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.
units.failure: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。~A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served.
units.misconception: 只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半~Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
units.practice: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 到站變異與平均等候~Arrival variability and mean waiting
units.title: 到站變異與平均等候~Arrival variability and mean waiting
units.mechanism: 當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。兩組平均班距相同的服務仍可能有不同等待時間，因此準點與均勻性具有獨立價值。 隨機到站旅客更容易遇到較長班距，因為長區間占較多時間，因此平均等候與班距變異數有關。公式假定旅客到達獨立於班表且每班可上車，不能表示服務櫃台或容量不足的隊列。 把不規則班距帶入隨機等候估算，活動批次到達另建事件模型。~With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway. More passengers encounter longer gaps. Services with identical mean headway can therefore have different waiting times, giving regularity a value separate from the average frequency. Random arrivals encounter longer headways more often because those intervals occupy more time. Mean waiting therefore depends on headway variance. The formula assumes arrivals independent of the timetable and successful boarding on every train; it does not model counters or capacity-constrained queues. Estimate random waiting from irregular headways and separately model event-release batches.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mean=187.2 s; sd=60 s；計算：wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=103.2154 s。敏感度：mean 單獨增加百分之十至 205.92 s，其餘固定，結果為 111.7013 s。模型邊界：獨立隨機旅客到達、穩態班距且皆可登車；不含時刻表配合到站。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mean=187.2 s; sd=60 s; calculation: wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=103.2154 s. Sensitivity: mean, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 205.92 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 111.7013 s. Model boundary: Random independent passenger arrivals, stationary headways and no denied boarding; timetable-aware arrivals are excluded.
units.verify: 從連續到站紀錄計算班距平均與變異數，再用匿名旅客到站時刻重播等待，檢查是否存在容量不足或非隨機到站。 從逐列到站時間重建班距平均與標準差，將旅客隨機到達事件重播，核對等候樣本平均。~Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals. Reconstruct mean and standard deviation from successive train arrivals, replay random passenger arrivals, and compare the sampled mean waiting time.
units.failure: 只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。 若滿載造成無法上車，需額外追蹤留下隊列而不能沿用公式。~Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula. When full trains prevent boarding, track the remaining queue separately instead of reusing this formula.
units.misconception: 兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間~Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time.
units.practice: 保持平均班距不變，把標準差減半後重算等待，並用一組確定性到站時間說明公式假設何時失效。 再以本單元 mean 的對照值重算 wait，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Hold mean headway fixed and halve its standard deviation, recalculate waiting, then use deterministic arrivals to show when the formula assumptions fail. Also recalculate wait for the alternative mean value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.mechanism: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 將散場人流分配到月台不同區域，保留疏散通道。~Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Distribute the post-event crowd across platform zones while preserving egress routes.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=437 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.248571 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 481至 481 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.374286 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=437 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.248571 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 481, to 481 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.374286 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded.
units.verify: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。~Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously.
units.failure: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。~A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones.
units.misconception: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞~Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
units.practice: 模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 停準誤差與月台門對位~Stopping error and platform-door alignment
units.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位~Stopping error and platform-door alignment
units.mechanism: 列車停準與月台門對位由列車位置、門中心距和控制容差共同決定。多個獨立誤差可用平方和開根號描述標準差，但系統偏差須另加；幾何對位也不能代替障礙物偵測和關門互鎖。 停車、測量與門位置三個獨立零均值誤差以變異數相加，再取平方根得到合成標準差。這不是最大偏移保證，也不含共同系統偏差；機械淨空及容許對位範圍須另外核對。 在活動尖峰停站情境量測停準和門位誤差，保留對位分布。~Train-to-platform door alignment combines stopping position, door spacing and control tolerances. Independent random errors can be combined by root-sum-square, but systematic offsets must be added separately. Geometric alignment does not replace obstruction detection or the door-closure interlock. Three independent zero-mean errors in stopping, surveying and door position combine through summed variances. The square root gives a standard deviation, not a guaranteed maximum offset. Shared bias is excluded, and mechanical clearance and permitted alignment ranges require separate checks. Measure stopping and door-position errors during event-peak stops and retain the alignment distribution.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：stop_sigma=0.0832 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m；計算：combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08687485 m。敏感度：stop_sigma 單獨增加百分之十至 0.09152 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.09487313 m。模型邊界：獨立零均值誤差；不是最大誤差界限，也未給允收公差。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: stop_sigma=0.0832 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m; calculation: combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08687485 m. Sensitivity: stop_sigma, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.09152 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.09487313 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean errors; not a maximum bound and no acceptance tolerance is specified.
units.verify: 以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。 以獨立基準重複量測停準與門位，檢查各誤差平均值、相關性和單位，再核對合成分布。~Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions. Repeat stopping and door-position measurements against an independent reference, check each mean, correlation and unit, and compare the combined distribution.
units.failure: 定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 若共同定位偏差存在，平方和模型會低估實際對位偏移。~Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A shared positioning bias makes the root-sum-square model understate actual alignment offset.
units.misconception: 停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移~A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
units.practice: 把隨機誤差和固定偏移分開做誤差預算，畫出不同載重的停準分布，列出對位與互鎖需分別驗證的證據。 再以本單元 stop_sigma 的對照值重算 combined_sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build separate random-error and fixed-bias budgets, plot stopping distributions at different loads, and list distinct evidence for alignment and interlocking. Also recalculate combined_sigma for the alternative stop_sigma value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.mechanism: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 對通訊遲到的車門與列車狀態保留禁止發車條件。~A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Retain departure-inhibition conditions when door or train-state messages arrive late.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.312 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.8 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3432 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.58 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.312 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.8 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3432 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.58 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.
units.verify: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。~Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption.
units.failure: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。~Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.
units.misconception: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達~A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
units.practice: 把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 振動隔離與頻率比~Vibration isolation and frequency ratio
units.title: 振動隔離與頻率比~Vibration isolation and frequency ratio
units.mechanism: 浮動道床可用彈簧質量阻尼器理解，其隔振效果取決於激振頻率與固有頻率的比值。接近共振時柔軟支承反而會放大響應，超過隔振區後才可能衰減；靜態撓度與動態效果需要同時檢查。 此式描述單自由度線性隔振系統的力傳遞率，頻率比是激振頻率除以固有頻率。增加阻尼有助於抑制共振，但在高頻隔振區不一定降低傳遞；必須先辨認工況所在區域。 對冷房設備基座檢查隔振傳遞率，區分阻尼與剛度變化。~A floating track slab can be understood as a spring-mass-damper system whose isolation depends on excitation-to-natural-frequency ratio. Soft support can amplify response near resonance before attenuating higher frequencies. Static deflection and dynamic performance therefore need to be checked together. This expression describes force transmissibility of a linear single-degree-of-freedom isolator. Frequency ratio is excitation frequency divided by natural frequency. Added damping suppresses resonance but need not reduce transmission in the high-frequency isolation region, so identify the operating region first. Check transmissibility of cooling-equipment mounts and distinguish damping from stiffness changes.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：ratio=3.12 1; zeta=0.12 1；計算：transmissibility=((1+(2*zeta*ratio)**2)/((1-ratio**2)**2+(2*zeta*ratio)**2))**0.5=0.1425072 1。敏感度：ratio 單獨增加百分之十至 3.432 1，其餘固定，結果為 0.1198468 1。模型邊界：線性單自由度力傳遞率；不含土層波傳、側向耦合及建築響應。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: ratio=3.12 1; zeta=0.12 1; calculation: transmissibility=((1+(2*zeta*ratio)**2)/((1-ratio**2)**2+(2*zeta*ratio)**2))**0.5=0.1425072 1. Sensitivity: ratio, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 3.432 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.1198468 1. Model boundary: Linear single-degree-of-freedom force transmissibility; soil propagation, lateral coupling and building response are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測軌道、道床與鄰近結構振動，使用頻譜比值而非只比較總加速度，並記錄列車速度與載重。 同步量測基座與支承反力頻譜，核對激振頻率、固有頻率和阻尼，檢查兩測點相位。~Measure rail, slab and neighbouring-structure vibration synchronously, compare spectra rather than only overall acceleration, and retain train speed and load. Measure base and transmitted-force spectra synchronously, verifying excitation frequency, natural frequency and damping while checking phase between measurement points.
units.failure: 隔振墊硬化會提高固有頻率，局部短路接觸則繞過彈性路徑；兩者都可能讓預期隔振頻段失效。 阻尼器劣化與剛度改變會有不同頻譜，須分開辨識。~Pad hardening raises natural frequency, while a rigid local contact bypasses the elastic path; either can remove the intended isolation band. Damper deterioration and stiffness change produce different spectral effects and must be identified separately.
units.misconception: 支承越柔軟所有頻率的振動就一定越小~Softer supports necessarily reduce vibration at every frequency.
units.practice: 計算接近共振與高頻兩種頻率比，畫出傳遞率趨勢，提出能辨別材料硬化與剛性短路的量測位置。 再以本單元 ratio 的對照值重算 transmissibility，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate near-resonant and high-frequency ratios, plot the transmission trend, and propose sensor locations distinguishing material hardening from a rigid bypass. Also recalculate transmissibility for the alternative ratio value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.mechanism: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 比較散場加密列車的受電重疊與可回收煞車能量。~Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings. The efficiency must cover a declared conversion chain. If it includes network receptivity, the observation window must be stated. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Compare receptivity overlap and recoverable braking energy in intensified post-event service.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=249600 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=14.08333 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 274560 kg，其餘固定，結果為 15.49167 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=249600 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=14.08333 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 274560 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.49167 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded.
units.verify: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。~Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice.
units.failure: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。~Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together.
units.misconception: 只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網~Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
units.practice: 比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 備援電池與可維持時間~Backup battery endurance
units.title: 備援電池與可維持時間~Backup battery endurance
units.mechanism: 備援電池可供負載使用的能量由額定容量、允許放電深度和轉換效率相乘，除負載功率得到理想時間。低溫、老化及啟動電流會縮短可用時間；額定安時也不能直接當成瓦時。 可用電量應扣除允許放電深度與轉換損失，負載也可能隨時間變化。銘牌容量的測試溫度和放電倍率會影響實際結果，續航計算不能取代受控放電驗證。 按乘客資訊與照明分列緊急電量，不以額定電池直接推定續航。~Usable backup energy combines rated energy, permitted discharge fraction and conversion efficiency. Dividing by load gives ideal endurance. Cold temperature, ageing and start-up current can shorten it; an ampere-hour rating must not be mistaken directly for watt-hours. Usable energy must account for permitted discharge depth and conversion losses, while load may vary over time. Test temperature and discharge rate influence rated capacity, so an endurance calculation cannot replace controlled discharge verification. List emergency energy for information and lighting separately rather than inferring endurance from rated battery capacity.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.8 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.744 h。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 22.88 kWh，其餘固定，結果為 4.1184 h。模型邊界：固定負載與額定能量；不含電池倍率效應、溫度與容量衰退。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=20.8 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW; calculation: endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.744 h. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22.88 kWh, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4.1184 h. Model boundary: Constant load and nominal energy; rate effects, temperature and capacity degradation are excluded.
units.verify: 定期以已知負載做受控放電，量端電壓、電流及溫度，核對控制器切離點與真正可用能量。 以受控負載記錄電池電壓、電流與溫度，積分可用電量，核對低壓切斷時刻。~Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy. Record battery voltage, current and temperature under controlled load, integrate usable energy, and verify the low-voltage cut-off time.
units.failure: 老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 電池電壓正常不代表容量足夠，需檢查負載下放電曲線。~An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. Normal open-circuit voltage does not prove sufficient capacity; inspect the loaded discharge curve.
units.misconception: 備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間~Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration.
units.practice: 將負載增加一成並把可用容量降為老化假設值，重新計算時間，提出量測端電壓以外必須保留的證據。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 endurance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase load and reduce usable capacity for an ageing case, recalculate endurance, and identify evidence required beyond terminal-voltage readings. Also recalculate endurance for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

facts: 已查證背景：2019 年，多哈地鐵紅線南段於五月開始初期旅客服務。~Verified background: 2019, The southern Red Line section of Doha Metro began initial passenger service in May.

教學假設，單元 3：headway=187.2 s/train，計算 capacity=17307.69 persons/hour；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: headway=187.2 s/train, calculated capacity=17307.69 persons/hour; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 4：mean=187.2 s，計算 wait=103.2154 s；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 4: mean=187.2 s, calculated wait=103.2154 s; not measured performance.
